name: 21985-longprefill-qwen06bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-FP8, NOT SUBSTITUTED. ~1.1 GiB in a single safetensors shard, public and ungated, already in this machine's HF cache (see env.yaml). Block-FP8 weights (e4m3, weight_block_size 128x128, dynamic activation scaling) over a bf16 activation path.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. The natural topology for a 0.6B model: nothing is split, nothing is replicated, and no collective runs inside the forward pass.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM. 28 decoder layers; hidden_size 1024; 16 query heads over 8 kv heads at head_dim 128, so the query projection is 2048 wide -- twice the residual stream; intermediate_size 3072; SiLU MLP; RMSNorm eps 1e-6; rope_theta 1e6, no rope scaling, no sliding window; vocab 151936 with tied embeddings; max_position_embeddings 40960.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 3200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 2400 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: exactly 7000 prompt tokens and exactly 16 generated tokens per request, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. 99.8% of the tokens in the run are read rather than generated, so this is a prefill workload with just enough generation to be a serving run rather than a forward-pass microbenchmark.
purpose: A document analysis assistant reading 7000-token reports and returning brief verdicts, eight concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`; the interpreter is
#   named by configs/env.yaml `venv:`, and the hardware seal is in the same file.
#
# SEMANTICS: one H100 serving a 0.6B dense model at TP1, 7000 prompt tokens in and 16 out, eight
#   streams in flight. 99.8% of the tokens in the run are read rather than generated, so the wall
#   clock is the prefill path and almost nothing else.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- nested blocks are DROPPED, and a dropped block means the engine runs
# without something this file declares. A structured value must stay on one line. Environment
# variables cannot live here. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

# Qwen3ForCausalLM: 28 decoder layers, hidden 1024, 16 query heads over 8 kv heads at head_dim
# 128, intermediate 3072, vocab 151936, tied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 40960. Weights
# are block-FP8 (e4m3, weight_block_size 128x128, dynamic activation scaling); ~1.1 GiB of
# safetensors in a single shard, already in this machine's HF cache (see env.yaml). Public and
# ungated. NOT SUBSTITUTED.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-FP8

# ONE CARD. TP IS PART OF THE DECLARATION AND NOT A KNOB -- a different degree splits the
# per-layer per-token work differently and is therefore a different question.
tp-size: 1

# Everything else is left at the pinned commit's own default for this device. The one default
# worth watching is `chunked-prefill-size`, stock 8192 on an 80 GB H100, which is what makes a
# 7000-token prompt one unsplit extend batch; if a run log shows chunking, say so.
#
# Nothing here is tuned: there is no tuned.yaml and no tunable.yaml.
